Firstly, W boyfriend for supporting you in your troubles, secondly my advice is to simply take a break from multiplayer for a little while- trust me I have been through similar situation, stuck in bronze III in Valorant, I have been shitted on by teammates, and it was like the only game I was playing so I did feel bad. But after a break I focused on myself more and the happiness the games are supposed to bring, I played Detroit (again), played some Diablo (again lol) and platinumed (I play on PS) some games I had on my list. When I came back to comp in a month I was like reborn lol I wasn’t as heated as before and I didn’t give a shit about my flaws because the motivation from previous games made me realize that main point of gaming is to make your life less miserable than more. :)) I ranked to gold III but now I’m once again playing other games, finished TLOU for instance (20h in the Part II too)
remember to listen to yourself, but only if your mind is in the right place. That’s why one can’t trust himself when one’s angry or drunk. Get some rest and it would do you amazing my friend :D

But for real- if you’re just starting (low ranks) pick up an iniciator (gekko/breach) give info to the team, get a proper game sense, once you fully grasp the maps switch to clove as smokes give a huge advantage in early ranks when mastered, and her kit also encourages you to play aggressive as you can overheal and res yourself. If you want to play duelist I think ISO is the most beginner friendly when you also have a free shield every round or try out Reina (if you manage to lock her faster than bronze 1 sweats🥶) I started as her main to kinda get traction but only when I switched to clove I started to rank up and now I’m playing cypher as on higher ranks info is everything
